question: Should this consolidation expose `@openclaw/retry` through the plugin package-resolution graph as a supported contract, or keep the package internal behind the existing plugin-SDK runtime facade?
rationale: The diff changes generated plugin-SDK API and alias machinery, so merging determines a compatibility boundary that tests cannot settle and repository policy assigns to maintainers.

options.title: Keep Package Internal
options.body: Retain the shared leaf implementation but expose retry behavior to plugins only through a narrow documented plugin-SDK runtime facade.

options.title: Sponsor Public Package API
options.body: Explicitly accept `@openclaw/retry` as a supported plugin import and document and test its compatibility contract before merge.

options.title: Land Only The Narrow Bug Fix
options.body: Pause the broad consolidation and fix the memory-host Retry-After floor locally if the new cross-package contract is not worth maintaining.

recommendation.title: Keep Package Internal
recommendation.body: Retain the shared leaf implementation but expose retry behavior to plugins only through a narrow documented plugin-SDK runtime facade.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior Retry-After review and current package-consolidation work make this person the strongest available owner for the intended API boundary.
